messages:
Maia: Quick heads-up — we're running a shadowing run with Peregrine tomorrow 2024-05-14 10:00 PDT. Goal: verify Dedicated pool behavior (autoscale, priming, latency SLO) without affecting their production traffic. Shadow header will be X-Shadow: true; responses should NOT be returned to user.

Ryan: Pool/route details?

Maia: pool=dedicated-peregrine-us-west; ingress LB: lb.peregrine.us-west.redwood; expected baseline RPS 350, bursts to 900 for ~5m every 30m during the 3h window. Avg tokens/request ~1.2k. Quota committed: 500k tokens/day for the run window.

Tess: Autoscale proposal — min=4 nodes, max=24, scale-up when GPU util >60% for 90s, scale-cooldown=120s; scale-down only after sustained <25% for 15m. Also enable warmup=kv-priming-100.

Diego: We should also configure fallback policy: if queue wait >2s or p95 latency >500ms, route to fallback model r-2-small with reduced precision. Also set throttling for burst >1k RPS to avoid OOM.

Asha: I'm confirming customer will set shadowing header. Also need to collect feedback form post-run. I'll own the enablement note and send them the checklist.

Ryan: I'm going to pre-warm caches. Send me top prefixes file and I'll run the priming job. Priming script (runs on eng-runtime):
```
# priming job example
python tools/priming/run.py --pool dedicated-peregrine-us-west --prefix-file s3://redwood-ops/peregrine/priming-top100.txt --concurrency 20
```

Tess: Loadtest plan: 30m ramp from 50 RPS → 350 RPS steady → 900 RPS burst for 5m every 30m; total run window 3h. We'll run preliminary 10m smoke at <50 RPS to validate rollout.

Diego: Add KV cache validation: confirm KV cache hit rate >70% within first 20m. If not, mark as 'needs priming' and re-run priming.

OpsBot: Ticket created: CS-9482. Auto-note: scheduled run 2024-05-14T17:00:00Z. Participants: Maia, Ryan, Tess, Diego, Asha.

Maia: Can we get an ops oncall to watch the dashboard for the first 45m? Need watch for error spikes, queue length, and node OOMs.

Ryan: I'll be oncall for first 90m. Will instrument additional logs: `ingress.trace=1` and add a temporary alert: p95_latency > 350ms for 5m.

Asha: Customer-facing checklist (I'll send): shadow header instructions, start-of-run confirmation, expected metrics, contact list, KMS and audit log confirmation. Also request session IDs for failed samples for post-mortem.

Tess: Post-run action items: 1) export token usage and per-model latencies; 2) compare p95 vs SLO(200ms); 3) QA picks 200 sample responses for quality regression; 4) handoff to renewals if stable.

Maia: OK—I've uploaded the priming list to s3://cs-peregrine/priming-top100.txt and updated run doc in Confluence. Final thumbs? :thumbsup:

Diego: :thumbsup:

Ryan: :thumbsup:

Asha: :thumbsup: I'll ping customer to confirm shadows enabled.

Maia: Great — will post a start and finish message in this thread. Thanks everyone.
